General transform vocabulary is applied to restricted multiscales. Allowing identity/path as transform types can produce invalid interchange metadata; path is a field, and multiscales permits scale/translation only.

The by-construction bounded-memory assertion exceeds the pinned reader behavior for accepted strips. Actualchunk size may be an entire compressed plane; need a decode-size admission rule or a qualified fallback. The stated unverified latency assumption does not qualify this stronger allocation promise.

The executed identity subcheck is confounded by the successful project mutation before the whitespace change. Removing the claimed change produces the sameTrue result, so this witness does not discriminate that proposition. SHA256 itself is not alleged broken.
